pitch.text: Every term, thousands of naira in school fees move through one shared bank account.
The bursar guesses who paid from a name and an amount. Underpayments go unnoticed. Parents have to call just to check a balance.
Meet EduPay. Every student gets their own dedicated account numbers, on Nomba and Paystack.
A parent transfers from any bank. EduPay identifies the student automatically and reconciles in seconds. A small service charge is added on top, so the school always receives its full fee.
Parent paid at the school? The bursar records cash, cheque, POS, or a transfer to the school's own account, with a unique receipt number. Same engine. No service charge.
Every payment is classified: exact, underpayment, or overpayment, where the parent chooses a refund or a credit.
Admins, bursars and parents all see the same numbers, in real time. Each one sees only what they need.
EduPay. Know who paid, instantly. Start with a free one hundred and twenty day pilot for your school.

teaser.text: School fees. Still tracked on paper?
Shared accounts. Guesswork. Parents calling to ask if they have been credited.
Parents transfer to their child's own account and it reconciles in seconds. Paid at school? The bursar records it. Same balance everywhere.
EduPay. Know who paid, instantly. Start with a free one hundred and twenty day pilot for your school.

demo.text: A school registers in minutes: name, email, phone, and a quick read of how EduPay works. Then it confirms its email.
Every school is verified before it starts. EduPay is emailed the application, verifies it, and approves. The school receives its approval email with its free pilot dates.
Once approved, the principal signs in and enrols a student. Name, ID, class. That is all. EduPay creates their dedicated Nomba and Paystack account numbers, and a parent link code.
Every student gets their own account numbers, on both gateways. Share them with the parent, along with the link code.
The parent signs up, enters the code, and links their child. The account numbers are right there, ready to copy.

This is the bursar's dashboard, live. A parent pays the fee by transfer. It appears instantly, matched to the student, and the totals update. A short payment is flagged as an underpayment, with the balance. A cash payment recorded at the school, with its receipt number, joins the same feed.
Each payment sends the parent a receipt email, for bank transfers and for cash, with the amount, what it was applied to, and the balance.
The parent sees it in the app too. The balance drops to zero and the term shows paid, with no phone call to the school.
EduPay. Know who paid, instantly. Start with a free one hundred and twenty day pilot for your school.
